answer_1.quote: To personalize the abstracts, we prompted ... to rewrite the provided abstract as an abstract personalized to an author.

answer_4.quote: Participants were asked to read two paper abstracts ... After reading each abstract pair, participants identified what modifications they liked/disliked ... and provided a free‑text response on whether they preferred the generated abstract and why.
answer_4.guideline: Participants indicated preferences for modifications (like/dislike) and answered free‑text questions about the generated abstract.
